```{python}
# | echo: false
# | output: asis
# Key-findings box (#320): a renderer of key_findings.json, which the fit
# pipeline (or scripts/regenerate_key_findings.py) generates from the fit's own
# CSVs. All sentence logic lives in reporting.generate_key_findings so the prose
# cannot drift from the computation (#271). It independently rechecks the current
# automatic gate so stale "ok" JSON cannot release findings after a failed refit.
# Deliberately self-contained (no _setup.qmd dependency) so it remains robust in
# the #321 findings-first order.
import json as _kf_json
from pathlib import Path as _KFPath

from language_reading_predictors.statistical_models.reporting import (
    convergence_gate_clean_passed as _kf_gate_clean_passed,
)

_kf_path = _KFPath(".") / "key_findings.json"
_kf_gate_path = _KFPath(".") / "diagnostics_summary.json"
try:
    with open(_kf_gate_path) as _kf_gate_fh:
        _kf_gate = _kf_json.load(_kf_gate_fh)
except (FileNotFoundError, OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, _kf_json.JSONDecodeError):
    _kf_gate = None

if not _kf_gate_clean_passed(_kf_gate):
    _kf_gate_checks = (
        _kf_gate.get("checks", {}) if isinstance(_kf_gate, dict) else {}
    )
    _kf_failed = ", ".join(
        str(name) for name, ok in _kf_gate_checks.items() if ok is not True
    ) or "missing or internally inconsistent convergence summary"
    print(
        '::: {.callout-important title="Findings withheld: sampling-quality '
        'checks failed"}\n\n'
        f"The current fit did not pass the complete convergence gate "
        f"(failed or unavailable: {_kf_failed}), so no stored findings are "
        "released. See Technical checks before interpreting any estimate."
        "\n\n:::"
    )
elif not _kf_path.exists():
    print(
        '::: {.callout-note title="Key findings"}\n\n'
        "A key-findings summary is not available for this fit (it predates the "
        "key-findings feature). Re-run `scripts/regenerate_key_findings.py` over "
        "this output directory to generate one, or read the results section "
        "below.\n\n:::"
    )
else:
    with open(_kf_path) as _kf_fh:
        _kf = _kf_json.load(_kf_fh)
    _kf_status = _kf.get("status")
    if _kf_status == "gate_failed":
        _kf_checks = ", ".join(_kf.get("failing_checks", [])) or "unknown"
        print(
            '::: {.callout-note title="Key findings need regeneration"}\n\n'
            f"The stored summary records a failed gate (failing: {_kf_checks}), "
            "so no findings are summarised. Regenerate the key-findings file from "
            "the current clean fit before interpreting it."
            "\n\n:::"
        )
    elif _kf_status == "gate_exception":
        _kf_checks = ", ".join(_kf.get("waived_checks", [])) or "unknown"
        print(
            '::: {.callout-important title="Findings withheld: retired sampling-quality '
            'exception"}\n\n'
            "This stored summary used the retired model-spec gate exception "
            f"(checks: {_kf_checks}). It is treated as failed under the current "
            "trace-bound policy, so no findings are summarised. Regenerate the "
            "key-findings file after obtaining a clean fit.\n\n:::"
        )
    elif _kf_status == "ok" and _kf.get("sentences"):
        _kf_lines = "\n".join(f"- {s['text']}" for s in _kf["sentences"])
        print(f'::: {{.callout-tip title="Key findings"}}\n\n{_kf_lines}\n\n:::')
    else:
        _kf_reason = _kf.get("reason") or "the fit's summary files are missing"
        print(
            '::: {.callout-note title="Key findings"}\n\n'
            f"A key-findings summary is not available for this fit ({_kf_reason}). "
            "See the results section below.\n\n:::"
        )
```
